abShortlist.text: Tuned shortlist: play each pair and rate them. Neither tuned preset passed every limit; your ratings decide.

comment: Combat Lab settings (docs/COMBAT_LAB.md). showOnTitle: show the Lab on the title screen in any build (dev builds always do). levers: every rule the Lab can switch; 'default' is the cl_base value, data/lab/presets.json overrides them. Read only through src/core/combat/rules.gd. Lab Tuner (docs/LAB_TUNER.md): learnCost = how much rules text a player must learn when it's on (the complexity cost), offValue = the value that counts as off (false for switches, else the default), fights = the fights the lever matters in (screening runs only those).

levers.name: Move is separate
levers.hint: Off: moving uses an Action.

levers.name: Split move
levers.hint: Move, act, then keep moving.

levers.name: Quicks per turn
levers.hint: 0 = no cap.

levers.name: Turn structure
levers.hint: Team: the whole party, then all enemies. Alternate: one ally, one enemy. Initiative: the old order.

levers.name: Max MP
levers.hint: 0 = the character's own.

levers.name: MP per turn
levers.hint: -1 = the character's own.

levers.name: All cards cost MP
levers.hint: Off: only Major and Grand spells do.

levers.name: Keywords
levers.hint: Free: costs no MP. Swift: still spends your Action, but your Move comes back after it. Heavy: only playable before you move, and it uses up your Move. Follow-up: opens the named card next.

levers.name: Extra Free and Follow-up cards
levers.hint: Added to each deck.

levers.name: Enemy damage scale
levers.hint: Enemy data hits harder than cards do, so it scales further: attacks of about 1 to 4 before Enemy damage x and any scaled fight difficulty.

levers.name: Flat card numbers x
levers.hint: Lab cards are written in small numbers. Raise this when small numbers are off.

levers.name: Domino
levers.hint: A push chains into the unit it hits.

levers.name: Pit damage to party
levers.hint: 0 = a share of max HP (the old rule).

levers.name: Props kept
levers.hint: Share of a fight's props on the map.

levers.name: Tracking attack share
levers.hint: -1 = what the enemy data says.

levers.name: Things in the path take the shot
Round cap
levers.hint: 0 = none. Past it, the Upside-Down shifts.

levers.name: Enemy count
levers.hint: 0 = what the fight says.

levers.name: Goal override
levers.hint: Blank = what the fight says.

levers.name: Scaled fight difficulty
levers.hint: Each fight uses its own enemy HP, damage and count from data/lab/fight_scales.json.

levers.name: Enemy abilities tier
levers.hint: Enemy actions marked with a higher abilityTier are left out.

levers.name: Choose your order
levers.hint: Click an ally who hasn't gone to make them next. The timeline shows who has acted.

levers.name: Initiative from cards
levers.hint: A Quick or Swift card moves that unit earlier next round; Heavy moves it later.

levers.name: Delay
levers.hint: Pass and act after the next enemy, once a round per unit.

levers.name: Facing
levers.hint: Units face the way they last moved or attacked. Back and side hits deal more. Replaces flanking.

levers.name: Zones of control
levers.hint: Leaving a tile next to an enemy costs +1 Movement, or gives it a free hit.

levers.name: High ground
levers.hint: Raised tiles give +range and +damage downhill. Pushed off one, you fall.

levers.name: Body blocking
levers.hint: An ally standing between a telegraphed attack and its target takes the hit.

levers.name: Line of sight
levers.hint: Spells need a clear line. Walls, crates and Constructs block.

levers.name: Fog
levers.hint: Enemy plans in fog are hidden (?) until Light, Reveal or standing next to them.

levers.name: Charge-up spells
levers.hint: Charge cards fire at the start of your next turn at +1 Magnitude. Telegraphed: enemies try to dodge.

levers.name: Lingering fields
levers.hint: Spells leave terrain: fire, ice, sticky ground, glare, and floor that cracks into a pit after 2 hits.

levers.name: Vector weather
levers.hint: A strong and a weak Vector each fight.

levers.name: Overload
levers.hint: Cast one Magnitude above what you can afford by paying HP or Exhausting a card.

levers.name: Cross-ally reactions
levers.hint: Two allies hitting one tile with different Vectors in a round sets off a named reaction.

levers.name: Upgrade in combat
levers.hint: A card played N times becomes its + version for the fight.

levers.name: Status cards
levers.hint: Some enemy attacks shuffle junk into your deck: Fear, Burned, Tangled.

levers.name: Signature card
levers.hint: Each character has a unique card, always in their opening hand.

levers.name: Retain
levers.hint: Retain cards stay when the hand is discarded (only matters with Keep leftover cards off).

levers.name: Duet cards
levers.hint: Cards that need two specific characters adjacent.

levers.name: Duet Bond
levers.hint: The Bond a duet needs in the story.

levers.name: Reshuffle effect
levers.hint: When your deck reshuffles: gain 1 Surge, or lose 1 HP.

levers.name: Enemy roles
levers.hint: Shield bearer, Bomber, Anchor, Summoner, Copycat, where a fight marks them.

levers.name: Weak points
levers.hint: Hitting a marked side Staggers an enemy and cancels its telegraph.

levers.name: Morale
levers.hint: When an enemy dies, others nearby may panic. Bosses and mindless enemies don't.

levers.name: Boss plans shown
levers.hint: 2: bosses show their next 2 turns, the second faded.

levers.name: Downed allies
levers.hint: Carry: a downed ally lies on the board. Drag them with your Move or revive them with a heal. They're out only if hit while down.

levers.name: Swap in reserves
levers.hint: Bring a benched member in at the edge, replacing a downed or chosen ally.

levers.name: Bond in combat
levers.hint: Adjacent allies with the Bond share one free Quick a round.

levers.name: Class gauges
levers.hint: Each class has a meter and one spender: Momentum, Heat, Shadow, Faith, Tempo.

levers.name: Waves in a fight
levers.hint: Reinforcements through marked doors, warned a round early. Stand on a door to stop them.

levers.name: Bonus objectives
levers.hint: Optional goals, shown on the result screen.

levers.name: Retreat
levers.hint: If the whole party reaches the exit, the fight ends. You keep what you found but lose the reward.

levers.name: Environmental timers
levers.hint: A board clock: rising water, a collapsing floor, spreading fire.

levers.name: Choose after a fight
levers.hint: After a win: a new card, a gear upgrade, or remove a card.

levers.name: Card mastery
levers.hint: Using a card N times across a run unlocks its + version for that run.

levers.name: Board relics
levers.hint: Small rule changers that drop after wins.

levers.name: Hitstop
levers.hint: A short freeze on hits.

levers.name: Board kill cam
levers.hint: A quick zoom on pit, ledge, collision and explosion kills. Off at fast speed.

levers.name: Speed controls
levers.hint: A skip-enemy-animations toggle on the Lab bar; hold Shift to fast-forward.

levers.name: Plain-words log
levers.hint: Log lines like "Brick pushed the Ghoul into the pit."
